description: Derived average daily budget for a single PLA campaign on a specific date, sourced from os_ads_campaign_avg_daily_budget_projections (only meaningful when the marketplace has avgDailyBudgetEnabled). One row per campaign_id + derived_daily_budget for the requested date, in marketplace currency. The table's date is UTC, so the local __START_DATE_1__ is converted to UTC via __SP_TIMEZONE__. Required per-call filter: campaign_id. The Python layer reads derived_daily_budget from the first row and rounds it.

campaign_id.description: The PLA marketing campaign id whose derived daily budget is being looked up. Required per-call filter.

derived_daily_budget.description: Projected/derived daily budget for the campaign on the requested date, in marketplace currency. Non-additive level (a budget, not a summable measure); exposed as an attribute passthrough.

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0. Row-level passthrough report with no aggregated metric; KAM requires at least one metric to fetch.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_campaign_avg_daily_budget_projections` AS p JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON SAFE_CAST(p.marketplace_client_id AS STRING) = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND p.date = DATETIME(TIMESTAMP('__START_DATE_1__', '__SP_TIMEZONE__'), 'UTC') AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
